How to…

Code
library(improveR)

1 … all steps of an analysis Tree

Code
childResourcesATModeling <- improveR::loadChildResources(ident='/improve-tutorial/Modeling/') %>%
  select(data) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  select(""name"", ""entityId"", ""path"")

2 … get the workflow leading to a step

Code
envATReportingStep1 <- getStep(""/improve-tutorial/Reporting/Step 1"")

# get the workflow and show details on Step 'Modeling/Step 10'
envATReportingStep1$lineage$load(treeDepth=-1)

#show all steps which form part of the workflow
envATReportingStep1$workflow$df()

Note that before calling lineage$load(), the df() in the workflow binding will only return the step itself, i.e. Reporting/Step 1.

3 … get the elements aka resources of a step’s inventory

Code
# appraoch 1 
stepInventory <- loadChildResources(ident="/improve-tutorial/Modeling/Step 1")$data[[1]]
ncol(stepInventory)

# approach 2
envStep <- getStep(ident="/improve-tutorial/Modeling/Step 1")
stepInventory2 <- envStep$getStepInventory()$data[[1]]
ncol(stepInventory2)

# the approach with getStep returns two additional columns
setdiff(names(stepInventory2), names(stepInventory)) # 'isVersion', 'inventoryPath'

# approach 3
envStep <- getStep(ident="/improve-tutorial/Modeling/Step 1")
envStep$stepDf #no does not show content of inventory; in the inventory is more than remote files;

4 … remove a step from a workflow

Remove step from workflow leading a specific step
step$workflow$removeStep()

5 … get the outdated elements of an inventory

Code
envATReportingStep1 <- getStep("/improve-tutorial/Reporting/Step 1")
changedAndOutdatedFiles <- envATReportingStep1$workflow$changedAndOutdatedFiles()

#outdated elements in an inventory
inventory <- envATReportingStep1$getStepInventory()
inventoryOutdatedLinks <- inventory %>%
  select(data) %>%
  unnest(data) %>%
  filter(outdatedLink==TRUE) 
nrow(inventoryOutdatedLinks)

#outdated link in resource
x <- loadResource("/improve-tutorial/Reporting/Step 1")
x$outdatedLink  #outdatedLink can be FALSE even if in the inventory of the Step are outdated elements
  • elaborate on the difference between outdated elements of an inventory and changedAndOutdated in the workflow context
  • outdatedAndChanged is different; also includes changed; changes input is a different one; outdatedLink=>here only outdated links; changed: files are not the same; changed red frame; outdated yellow frame

6 … rerun changed and outdated steps with in a workflow

Code


step$workflow$rerunChangedandOutdated

7 Common Errors

7.1 Tooling

When defining a step’s tooling, no interactive e.g. RStudio instance is permissble. Executing a step via {improveR} requires a tooling which can be run in batch mode.
